name: js-frp
description: A library written in TypeScript for managing FRP instances. FRP is a fast reverse proxy to help you expose a local server behind a NAT or firewall to the Internet.

scripts.build: tsc && npm run download:frp && npm run build:frp && npm run build:copy-wasm-exec
scripts.build:frp: cd frp && env GOOS=js GOARCH=wasm go build -trimpath -tags frps -ldflags='-s -w' -o ../lib/frps.wasm ./cmd/frps && env GOOS=js GOARCH=wasm go build -trimpath -tags frpc -ldflags='-s -w' -o ../lib/frpc.wasm ./cmd/frpc

author: PondWader
